name: OX Quiz Widget
description: A mobile-friendly educational O/X quiz interface where users answer questions one at a time and receive immediate feedback with explanations.

requirement.summary: Build an O/X quiz widget for an educational mobile app that shows one question at a time, lets the user select O or X, reveals the correct answer with an explanation, tracks progress, and supports retrying the quiz.
details: Display the O/X quiz question list one question at a time
Provide O and X answer buttons for the user to choose from
After a selection, show whether the answer is correct and display the correct answer with an explanation
Lock answer buttons after selection until the user moves to the next question
Show a progress indicator with a completed count (e.g., '3/10 questions completed') and a visual progress bar
Show a completion summary with the final score when all questions are answered
Provide a retry (restart) feature that resets all state and starts the quiz from the first question
Use a responsive layout optimized for mobile and tablet screen sizes
Apply transition animations when switching questions and revealing results (Tailwind transition/animation utilities)
Support keyboard navigation: Tab focus order, Enter/Space to activate buttons, O/X key shortcuts to answer, Enter or the right arrow key to go to the next question
Include accessibility attributes: aria-labels on the O/X buttons, an aria-live region for result feedback, and progressbar role with aria-valuenow/aria-valuemax
Use a color scheme of green for correct answers, red for incorrect answers, and gray for neutral/unselected states
Use the system default font stack (Tailwind font-sans)

Split the UI into components: QuizContainer (overall layout and state management), QuestionCard (current question display), AnswerButtons (O/X selection buttons), ProgressBar (progress display), ResultDisplay (correct/incorrect feedback and explanation)
Manage state for the current question index, user answers, correctness of each answer, and completion status
Define a typed question data model (id, question text, correct answer 'O' | 'X', explanation) and include sample data with 10 questions
